description: Affine map from real controller values to CAD/URDF joint values. q_cad = cad_scale * real_SI + cad_offset.  Linear: real in mm -> m. rx: real in rad.
notes: Endpoints anchored to CAD joint limits; directions from measured real->cad correspondences.
All three linear axes are sign-flipped vs the CAD positive direction; rx is not.
Linear offsets = the CAD joint UPPER limit (real 0 anchors there, scale -1); rx offset = the CAD LOWER limit.
rx home (real 0 rad) = CAD -0.9599 rad (-55 deg tilt stop). Code moves rx to ~0.95 rad real after homing = ~level (cad ~0); home unchanged.
Re-fit these offsets after any CAD export that changes link frames or mate origins.
VALIDATION RULE: after any re-export, validate representative safe poses through the collision model before rebuilding the envelope (see cad/README.md).
